The claims it cites fit their sentences (C0072822 and C0072892 have 0 conditions with Z09 and R10.9; C0073123 and C0073255 are documented at high MDM). The inconclusive leaning and the caveat about the small sample are sensible. Weaknesses are small. The headline says 'at every complexity tier' but the summary says 'every complexity band', which the card supports. The next steps are somewhat generic and omit the specific claim IDs, and the 'Re-screen' step is vague. Some example claims (C0073157, a 99214) don't illustrate the 99215 point. It also does not note that C0073123 and C0073255 lack recorded minutes, except for 45 min on C0073255.","problems":["Next steps are generic and do not name the specific claims to request, even though the rationale mentions targeting low-complexity 99215 claims.","Example claims include C0073157, a 99214 below-billed case, which is tangential to the 99215 concern; the C0072797 and C0072820 examples are mild low-complexity cases rather than the strongest ones (0 conditions).","Does not point out that C0073123 had no recorded minutes, or that the high-MDM documentation cannot be checked against the diagnoses without the notes.","'Re-screen the provider once the records arrive' is vague and gives no criteria."]}
